name: Charge
description: Moving the pointer builds up a charge in the stroke behind it. A slow drift leaves a thin cyan line, and the longer and faster you move the hotter and wider it runs, climbing the spectrum toward rose. Stopping spends it. A bright pulse travels back down the whole stroke and leaves it quiet again, and a click spends it the same way wherever the pointer happens to be.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the stroke with no charge in it (px)

parameters.name: Swell
parameters.description: How many times wider the stroke runs at full charge

parameters.name: Lifetime
parameters.description: How long a point on the path stays lit (seconds)

parameters.name: Charge speed
parameters.description: Sustained pointer speed that reaches full charge (px per second)

parameters.name: Discharge
parameters.description: Brightness of the pulse that spends the charge, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Glow
parameters.description: Strength of the soft bloom around the stroke

parameters.name: Activation speed
parameters.description: Pointer speed below which the stroke is not drawn (px per second), 0 to always draw

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: How much the path is smoothed before it is drawn, 0 to follow it exactly
